$comment: Divergences from the live marketplace entry that are EXPECTED and have a PR that ends them. Read by test/submission-drift.mjs. Every entry names the exact upstream→draft pair it excuses; the moment that pair stops being true the gate reds, because a declaration that outlives its reason is a mute button. Only category / description.en / description.zh may appear here — a wrong url or name is a bug, not an in-flight disagreement.
